params.name: accountRef
params.description: The Id or Urn of the account

items.docs: BETAList available subscriptions into this account. Requires the permission `account:subscriptions:read` on the account. The `inviteAccountOwnerInNewProjects` property is only included when the caller is the account owner. The `end` property is only included when the caller has the `account:subscriptions:read-sensitive-infos` permission (account owner or administrator).
